name: TimeField
summary: A time of day typed in parts: hour, minute and, in a 12 hour locale, the day period, each a segment. Values are 24 hour HH:mm strings in and out, whatever cycle is drawn; the cycle, the order and the day period words come from Intl for the locale, and digits stay Western. On web a bordered box like Input; on ios the same segments in the platform field height; on android the Material time input (two fields, no clock dial) inside the DatePicker's dialog. Proposed.
useWhen: A time a person knows and types: an opening hour, a departure time
The time half of a date and time on web, next to the date chip
The android time dialog of DatePicker
avoidWhen: A time picked by flicking on a phone
A duration, which is a number of minutes, not a time of day

insteadUse.A time picked on a phone: WheelPicker (or DatePicker, which opens it on ios)

value.description: The time, controlled: a 24 hour HH:mm such as 21:05, or null for none.

onChange.description: Called with HH:mm once every segment is filled, and with null when one is cleared.

minValue.description: The earliest time, HH:mm. An earlier time marks the field invalid.

maxValue.description: The latest time, HH:mm. A later time marks the field invalid.

placeholderValue.description: The time the segments step from while empty, HH:mm. Default midnight.

locale.description: The locale of the segment order, the separator and the day period words, such as ar-SA. Default the language of the nearest Theme. Digits stay Western.

size.description: The box height: size.control.sm, md or lg (44, with a fixed 16px text so phones do not zoom).

invalid.description: Marks the field invalid (data-invalid, aria-invalid on the group). Inside a Field the field decides when it is not passed. A value outside min and max is invalid too.

disabled.description: No segment takes focus or changes. Stamps data-disabled.

readOnly.description: Segments take focus and are read; typing changes nothing. Stamps data-readonly.

required.description: aria-required on the group; the Field shows its mark.

autoFocus.description: Focuses the first segment on mount.

aria-label.description: The name of the field when no Field label names it.

name.description: The name of the hidden form input. React Aria writes HH:mm:ss there.

hourCycle.description: 12 or 24. Default the locale's own cycle (wheelHourCycle, the one WheelPicker uses): 12 in ar-SA and en-US, 24 in en-GB. The value is 24 hour either way.

a11y.role: group (the input part) named by aria-label or the Field label, holding a spinbutton for the hour, the minute and, in a 12 hour locale, the day period. Each is named by its part and the field name (hour, Start; الساعات، وقت البدء). Separators are aria-hidden.
a11y.focus: One Tab stop per editable segment, in reading order. A press on the box outside a segment focuses the first empty segment, else the last. The box takes the focus ring while any segment has focus; the focused segment takes the tint fill.

keys.Tab: Moves to the next segment, and out after the last
keys.ArrowUp: Steps the focused segment up; wraps within its range
keys.ArrowDown: Steps the focused segment down; wraps within its range
keys.ArrowRight: The next segment; the one before in right to left
keys.ArrowLeft: The segment before; the next one in right to left
keys.PageUp: Steps the hour up by 2, the minute by 15 (React Aria)
keys.PageDown: Steps the hour down by 2, the minute by 15
keys.Home: The least value of the segment
keys.End: The greatest value of the segment
keys.Backspace: Clears the last digit, then the segment, then moves to the segment before
keys.Digits: Type the hour and minute; focus moves on when the segment is full. A or P (ص or م) sets the day period. Arabic Indic digits are read as Western digits.
keys.Pointer: A tap on a segment focuses it; a tap on the box focuses the first empty segment. No drag.

a11y.announce: Start, group. Hour, Start, spin button, 9 PM. Minute, 05. AM/PM, PM. React Aria's hidden description reads the whole time after a change.
notes: The box is control md tall (32) on web, never under 24 (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8). ios and android raise it through their platform rules (requested).
The day period words come from Intl for the locale with Arabic marks removed: AM and PM, ص and م. In Arabic the hour sits at the right and the day period at the left.
Digits stay Western in every segment, placeholder, name and announcement in ar-SA, proved by a unit test.
React Aria joins a segment name and the field name with a Latin comma; in Arabic the system writes the Arabic comma instead.
No clock dial anywhere: a dial is a drag (WCAG 2.2 2.5.7). On android the time is this field in a dialog.
Under forced colors the focused segment is Highlight with HighlightText and the focus outline shows.

en.aria-label: Names the time: Start time, Pickup time. Sentence case.
en.segments: Segment names, placeholders and day period words come from React Aria and Intl.

ar.aria-label: اسم بصيغة اسمية بدون تشكيل: وقت البدء، وقت الاستلام.
ar.segments: أسماء الأجزاء وكلمتا الفترة من Intl: ص و م، والأرقام لاتينية.

react.behavior: React Aria TimeField, DateInput and DateSegment (react-aria-components) through their render props, on DateField's segment row; HH:mm helpers in TimeField/time.ts, the hour cycle from wheelHourCycle in @the-system/shared
react.note: Motion: as DateField (fade on the focused segment and the border). Reduced motion: instant.

angular.note: New wave 2: the same DOM on the shared date and wheel helpers; Angular has no React Aria, so the segment keys are built on the CDK with the keyboard map of this manifest.

native.note: Phase R5 uses a system view: the compact time picker of iOS and the Material time input on Android, through @expo/ui.

styles.web: A bordered box like Input holding hour, minute and the day period in tabular digits.
styles.ios: The same segments in a 44 point field; on a phone DatePicker opens the wheel instead.
styles.android: The Material time input: the hour and the minute as two filled boxes and the day period beside them, in the DatePicker dialog (requested from the platform file).
styles.studio: The same on the Studio tokens; no recipe.
styles.desk: The same on the Desk tokens; no recipe.
styles.neutral: The same on the Neutral tokens; no recipe.
styles.liquid: The same on the Liquid tokens; no recipe.
